restatement_groups.reason: Both require the approval marking to be borne on / affixed to the lamp; the general marking requirement is repeated in the marking-location paragraph.

Both require the trichromatic coordinates of light retro-reflected by red, amber or white retro-reflective devices to fall within the UN R48 night-time colour limits. R-0222 is the general requirement (para 4.2.1.2); R-0238 repeats it in the Class IA/IB section (para 5.1.5.2).
